record.source: ARM9 02062100 creates R, OVL0 context+108 owns stride-1C8 records, context+104 contains pointers
record.hpInitialization: R+50 and R+58 receive the same HP. W+4E8=current HP; W+4EC=max HP are separate copies
record.rng: Normal entry consumes the continuing app RNG through verified species/pool/AI/position/grouping sources. Save v5 preserves RNG/history. Return consumes one channel1 draw per actual returned card. Historical live receipts remain research only; no future RNG result list is installed.
record.formula: base + 10 * remainder(B7, trunc(trunc((nextRungHp-base)/2)/10)); this ROM returns remainder 0 for divisor 0
record.scope: Normal unaccompanied native entry and tools are bound; NATIVE_LIVE_STATE_REPLAY remains an explicitly supplied research fixture only.

rope.coefficient: Original u16 table 020C98BC + ropeIndex*28 + generation-column + max(species[70]-1,0)*2; coefficient supplied by trace
rope.slack: Squared distance <40^2: durability +10 capped at max; no direct HP damage
rope.pull: 40^2 <= squared distance <80^2: accumulator += damageQ12; durability -1, extra -1 if species[71]==2
rope.strong: Squared distance >=80^2: accumulator += 2*damageQ12; durability -1, extra -2 if species[71]==2; dispatch 11 or blocked 13; blocked costs one more durability
rope.damageWriter: If accumulator >=4096, W.HP -= accumulator>>12 clamped at zero; then subtract exactly 4096 from accumulator, not modulo
rope.break: Squared distance strictly >160^2 sets durability zero; <=0 durability enters break state
rope.tick: One call is one native update invocation, never an assumed browser frame or arbitrary milliseconds
rope.implementationLimit: Normal controller binds compared strong/slack/pull writers and AI8 event11/13 reactions. Complete browser touch capture, original tool presentation and AI7 remain separate acceptance requirements.
rope.movementBlocked: Numerical input represents W+4FC movement-restriction flag, not a direct collision-grid verdict; AI8 event13 can set it via a random stun timer.
rope.nativeTouchValidation: 198 actual stylus-driven Rope invocations match HP/durability/accumulator including events11/13. State-specific AI handling remains outside the numerical function.

collection.down: Observed AI8 HP0 -> next-update AI10 entry starts W+11C=15 with vertical shake -> countdown checked before decrement -> AI11 entry writes W+4F8=1. This live path leaves W+50C=0; do not substitute the separate 0210CBBC downPhase path.
collection.hand: Event16, actual on-card species G sum plus incoming G <= owned card max; overcapacity event39 leaves wild present
collection.accepted: Event20 schedules collection; no immediate card count change
collection.insert: OVL0 02117458 insertion subphase increments its counter; only counter >10 copies R into card[count] and increments count
collection.animationBoundary: Normal native clock owns down and hand/card phases. Active native clocks reject early-completion APIs; renderer callbacks cannot insert a card. See the Hunt core implementation for normal input/AI/timeline tests.
collection.hpOwnership: Card copies source R; it does not copy depleted W.HP. This bounded capture has W.HP=0, R.HP=210, card.HP=210
collection.duplicates: Repeated hand/insertion/confirm intents do not append a second record
collection.nativeObservedTimeline: Gate0 actual wild7: HP0 frame351; hand-ready frame367; card count1 frame480. Observations, not universal delays. Card retains sourceHP210.

home.native: OVL14 0210C03C -> ARM9 02061BB4 inserts R into first free slot of 16-slot pool (slot stride 1CC, record at +4), marks database flag, clears card count after loop
home.app: exitHunt opens existing HUNT_RESULT with pending card; name edits update card; confirmHuntResult stages existing ID allocator and Raising collection
home.save: Existing save port writes candidate collection and high-water mark together; only success publishes live roster and clears card
home.failure: Keep result screen and card in memory, leave roster/ID unchanged, retry through same app transaction
home.saveGuard: Standalone save cannot silently serialize Home while a captured card awaits commit
home.capacity: 16-slot capacity checked after staged releases. Card/Home rows ordered as original; all Home identities including starter/residents support confirmation/cancel. Canonical nested Raising schema v5 persists resident membership; validated v1-v4 migrate without silently accepting a truncated old roster.
home.durableExtension: Optional raising.collection[].nativeProfile stores exactly 108 known u32 fields, five narrow fields, a five-UTF16-unit source name and version1; strict validation. Existing capturedVitals and legacy records remain valid.
home.profile: Actual per-individual HP/TP and known stat fields are projected when nativeProfile exists. No growth/evolution/lifetime/skills or player party consumer is inferred.
home.provenance: New normal captures: NATIVE_NORMAL_HUNT_CONTROLLER. Explicit replay retains ROM_DATAFLOW_REPLAY_NOT_FIELD_PARITY. Full hardware/save/field parity is not asserted.
home.releaseFailure: Home removal, capture insertion, cage/care cleanup and ID allocation save atomically. Failure retains original Home, card and staged choice for retry.

returnWriter.transaction: Validate candidate records/RNG/history before committing; one return writer per expedition. Result/Home uses existing atomic save and ID allocation.
